title: With Require Tech Story off, the report text ends after the description
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is off.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154716 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154716 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has an approved labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "Replace tie rod") and Description (for example "excessive play"), not yet completed, with no tech story.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Complete {Line-1} without writing a tech story.
  3. Set {Work-order-1}'s status to Complete.
  4. Open the Finance tab and click Create Invoice.
  5. Close the New Customer Payment window without taking a payment.
  6. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  7. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  8. Set the date range to cover today.
  9. Download the report.
  10. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  11. Find the row for {Line-1} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  12. Click an empty cell, type =LEN( then click that ItemDescription cell, type ) and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the line completes without asking for a tech story.
  • Step 4: the invoice is created and {Work-order-1} shows Invoiced.
  • Step 11: the cell reads the title, " - ", then the description, and ends there (with the example values "Replace tie rod - excessive play"): no trailing hyphen, no trailing space, no "Tech Story".
  • Step 12: with the example values the number is 32 (15 + 3 + 14 = 32).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R6, S3-R6a, S3-R3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (What reaches QuickBooks) and 2.1 (Awkward inputs), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-009; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R6: “A line with no narrative ends after the description, with no trailing hyphen and no trailing space. A narrative is absent when the value is empty, or when it is the literal placeholder "Tech story missing." that the line dialog writes when nothing was typed; the two are treated identically, and neither reaches QuickBooks.”
  • S3-R6a: “A narrative is absent legitimately, not only exceptionally. The organization setting Administration, Work Order Settings, Require Tech Story governs whether the completion gate gets in the way, so a shop with it switched off invoices completed lines with no narrative as a matter of course.”
  • S3-R3: “A separator appears only between two segments that are both present. A line with no description joins the title straight to the narrative. A line with no narrative ends after the description. A line with neither carries the title alone. In every case there is no trailing separator and no trailing space.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given a line with a title and a description but no narrative, then the text ends after the description with no trailing hyphen and no trailing space.”
  • PRD Key Decisions (Require Tech Story): “Administration, Work Order Settings, Require Tech Story: "Tech story will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order." With it on, the completion gate refuses an empty value and every invoiced line carries one. With it off, a line is completed and invoiced without one, and the text simply ends after the description.”
